title: Unexpected Task Interruption During Code Generation Workflow
body:
**Bug Description**
Out of the blue, claude code has just started halting in the middle of tasks - it'll do some step, and then just do nothing, but will accept another prompt and then hang in the same way.

I tried restarting with a --resume, but just got the same thing. I guess I'll need to just try a new session?

**Environment Info**
- Platform: darwin
- Terminal: Apple_Terminal
- Version: 1.0.53
- Feedback ID: b3a928b9-e20c-4bbe-b20d-f18eb0164821
author: cjw296

top_comments.author: ArturoTorresMartinez
top_comments.body: Same here, apparently we all started having issues in the last couple of hours because of an update they just pushed...

top_comments.author: cjw296
top_comments.body: :sand-panda: - @ArturoTorresMartinez - where did you see this? Server side or client side push? (guessing server side given that I haven't seen any client-side updates come through...)

top_comments.author: tad-hq
top_comments.body: Same issue here, best of luck everyone.
